description.value: A Starbucks Coffee location in south Vancouver on Ontario Street, part of the global coffee chain known for espresso drinks, teas, and light food items. The location operates with takeout and online ordering options. As a chain outpost in a residential-commercial area of Vancouver, it offers a predictable and accessible stop along a cycling route.
